title: Low and Green Fire
description: Clean low fire with bright green flames for better PvP visibility.Best for Cpvp!!
body: ## 📖 Description **This Green Low Fire resource pack is designed for players who want improved visibility, smooth performance, and a clean combat experience during competitive matches. It replaces Minecraft's default fire with a minimal, low-height green fire effect, reducing visual obstruction while maintaining a unique and stylish appearance. The pack keeps Minecraft's original feel while enhancing visibility, allowing you to focus on PvP without unnecessary distractions.** ## ✨ Key Features 🟢 **Clean & Minimal Green Fire** — Replaces the default fire with a stylish low-height green animation. ⚔️ **PvP-Optimized Design** — Improves visibility during combat by reducing screen obstruction. 👀 **Better Visibility** — Makes fights clearer and helps you stay focused in intense PvP situations. ⚡ **Lightweight & Performance-Friendly** — Optimized for smooth gameplay on both low-end and high-end devices. 🎯 **Built for Competitive Gameplay** — Perfect for UHC, PvP, BedWars, SkyWars, and other fast-paced game modes. ## 🧩 **Compatibility** ✅ Compatible with most modern Minecraft Java Edition versions. ✅ Fully supports both Vanilla Minecraft and OptiFine. ✅ Optimized for smooth performance on both low-end and high-end PCs. 📜 **Credits & Usage** 🎥 Feel free to use this resource pack in your videos or livestreams with proper credit. 🔄 Redistribution, modification, or reuploading of this pack is allowed only with clear credit to the original creator [Not_Treet69].
